summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge: analyze Soony's confidential launch data, find hidden risks, and build a general agent product (poller, versioned store, LLM analysis, supplier email, dashboard) that acts on new data drops.
summary.outcome: Found that the launch plan hides real gaps (art books, statues, game cards, card cases, sleeve revision). Built and pushed a portal watcher with a one-off download command. Set up Gmail SMTP/IMAP and resolved the Boise delivery-terms thread by email. Built change-summary versioning and a password-protected dashboard served through a Cloudflare tunnel. Committed locally, not yet pushed.

repo: The portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip), with no webhooks. Files are replaced under the same name, so change detection has to compare SHA-256 checksums.

The team workflow (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, PROGRESS.md) is to claim work in the 'Now' section of PROGRESS.md, `git pull --rebase`, and push straight to main, with no branches or PRs. PROGRESS.md is the usual conflict point.
Confidential portal data, scans, inbox/outbox, findings notes and .env are all in gitignored paths (data/, .env). Only code, tests, README and .env.example are committed.

Versioned store keeps files by checksum under data/store/blobs, which is unreadable for browsing; `ask-soony download` mirrors current files under their original paths (default data/portal/) with path-traversal checks.
The Entire hook only creates a checkpoint when repo files change, and it pushes checkpoints on git push. Commits may need extra hook timeout.

Suppliers share one inbound mail domain (suppliers.juliansibbing.de) and appear automated. They reply in about 3-4 minutes, in-thread via In-Reply-To, and only to senders registered in portal Settings.
dashboard.py and store.py are exempt from the linter's line-length rule because of long inline HTML/CSS strings.
Change summaries are deterministic: CSV row/column diffs with rename detection on shared rows only, Excel cell diffs, and text line diffs. They need no LLM key.

code.finding: Column rename detection must only compare values on rows present in both versions, otherwise added rows make column lengths differ and detection fails.
Dashboard is protected by a password from .env, since it exposes confidential data, and is served by `ask-soony serve` behind a Cloudflare tunnel.

workflow: Checking the Entire logs showed the hooks had fired but skipped checkpointing because no files were modified.
A subagent cross-checking 200 order confirmations and 59 scans against SAP surfaced the key discrepancies (overbooked art books, failed statue lot, sleeve revision) faster than reading them serially.

Cloudflare Email Routing receiving needs Cloudflare-controlled MX. A subdomain (agents.stenglein.dev) can be routed alongside a root domain on Private Email, but sending needs Workers Paid; a fresh Gmail account with an app password was the fast fallback.
The hackathon network blocks QUIC (UDP), so cloudflared tunnels must run over HTTP/2.
The agent asks before pushing or sending outward-facing mail, and keeps secrets (passwords, tokens) out of output and docs.

friction: The portal token was empty at first, which blocked data access until the user supplied it.
The Cloudflare route needed Workers Paid ($5/month), and Email Sending returned 401 without it; the user chose Gmail instead.
The user's main domain mail is hosted at Private Email, which ruled out Email Routing on it and led to repeated rethinking of the mail setup.
The PROGRESS.md rebase conflict with a teammate's line had to be resolved by hand.
QUIC being blocked on the hackathon Wi-Fi broke the first tunnel start.
The first change-summary rename-detection test failed when rows had been added.
Portal data kept changing (new drops at 14:37 and 16:57), so the earlier briefing page and doc went stale.
Supplier reply timing and whether replies are automated were unclear until the first Boise response.
open_items: Send the Karton Nowak order for 8,000 art books (offer valid about 24h, 16,800 EUR). Awaiting user go-ahead.
Analyze the 16:57 drop with the LLM agent, which needs an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env.
Build the mail outbox with approval, the IMAP inbox with reply matching and the supplier allowlist into the watcher; currently done through ad-hoc scripts.
Push the latest commits (change summaries and dashboard) after pull --rebase.
Update the briefing page and Claude doc to the 14:37 and 16:57 states, and decide whether to delete the older doc.
Decide the deploy target (ada vs Mac vs Cloudflare); the dashboard currently runs on the Mac via tmux and a tunnel, not on ada.
Register or confirm the sender address in the portal, and decide on removing the agents.stenglein.dev Email Routing subdomain setup.
Soony-internal fixes to raise: correct DDP to EXW on open Boise POs in SAP, the statue lot sorting sign-off, and the card case pickup at the Hamburg terminal.
Await Boise's flight details and freight costs; also ask the Lio engineers whether portal data is the same for every team and whether supplier replies create portal files.
